I answered Tobias in a thread in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

The answer comes from that channel, which Tobias is a member of. On 2025-09-03, Priyanka said label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that "Southgate dispatch" had totes stacked beside door 4. Her resolution message later that day said "Southgate cleared the backlog."

I told him the channel doesn't give a street address or any other details for the site. There's also no Tansley account folder among the files he can see.
